note: Gate C W2 — C04 (Round Board planning open, unresolved player decision), C05 (planning closed, historical warnings, mixed boundary), C06 (dense allocation, position-precision disclosure). No official Gate C wave-ordering document exists (see SOURCE_RECONCILIATION.md) — this wave's scope is self-assigned and provisional, exactly as Gate C W1 disclosed for C01-C03. The production audit found two genuine defects, both fixed here: (1) RoundPlanIntegrity.coverage was computed but never surfaced anywhere in the UI (C04's required eligible-player denominator was simply missing); (2) the assignment-suggestion commit path (handleAssignSuggestion) had no isFinalized guard, unlike the allocation matrix's handleMatrixToggle, so a closed match could render as an assignable destination and accept a committed assignment (C05). Both are fixed and regression-tested at the production-component level, not only inside this wave's own fixtures. C06's literal '24-slot precision vs 14 general roles' acceptance question was found, by direct audit of prisma/schema.prisma and src/domain/positions/, to be a genuine source gap: Round Board's Selection model has no position field at all, and the real 24-code/14-code vocabularies belong to the separate Lineup/Formation editor. This is disclosed as BLOCKED_BY_SOURCE_OR_AUTHORITY, not fabricated; a small, real navigation addition (a 'View exact position in Lineup' link from the assignment inspector to the player's current match) is shipped instead, per the brief's own explicit allowance. See CURRENT_STATE_AUDIT.md, OPPORTUNITY_COVERAGE_SEMANTICS.md, CLOSED_STATE_RULES.md, and POSITION_VOCABULARY_AND_PRECISION.md for full detail. All three candidates remain CANDIDATE pending owner review.
